title.zh: 【DriveWealth 与 Ripple 达成合作，将机构数字资产基础设施引入全球投资】

current_state.zh: DriveWealth partners with Ripple to integrate stablecoin, payments, custody, and prime brokerage infrastructure into its global investment platform, starting in Europe and expanding to the US.
